question: The concept of "Amendment of the Constitution" in the Indian Constitution was borrowed from the constitution of which of the following countries?
solution:
The correct answer is __**South Africa.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Amendment of the Constitution:-**

 
 
• **The concept of "Amendment of the Constitution" in the Indian Constitution was borrowed from the constitution of South Africa. (Hence option 2 is correct)**
 
• **Article 368 of the Indian Constitution lays down the procedure for amendment of the Constitution. **
 
• It is based on the Article 74(1) of the Constitution of South Africa, which provides that the Constitution can be amended by a two-thirds majority of the members of the Parliament, present and voting, provided that the amendment is not inconsistent with the fundamental principles of the Constitution.
